import json,hashlib,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,torch

from experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.native30_data import Native30Data

data=Native30Data(BASE/cfg['train_manifest'],'validation',cfg['seed']+1,frames=cfg['frames'],memory_protocol=cfg['scene']['memory_protocol'],quality_config=cfg['gt_reliability'],exo_max_empty_frames=cfg['exo_max_empty_frames'],**window_options(cfg))
data.runtime_cache_root=out/'native30_runtime_cache_v2'
old_path=data.scene_memory._cache_path
data.scene_memory._cache_path=lambda *args:(p if (p:=old_path(*args)) is not None and p.exists() else None)
data.surface_cache=CanonicalSurfaceCache(data,limit=1);data.scene_memory.cached_streams=1
builder=Native30ObservationBuilder(Native30SkinAnchorCache(),read(BASE/cfg['mount_defaults']),cfg['observation']['input_noise'])
rows=[]
for e in plan['entries']:
 members=[i for i,(meta,_) in enumerate(data.members[e['group']]) if meta['path']==e['path']]
 sample,identity=data.sample(e['group'],'ego',member=members[0],start=e['start'],yaw=0)
 _,scene,asset=builder.build(data,sample,identity,'ego',(15,),noise_rng=None)
 start=time.monotonic();weak=training_support_targets(sample,scene,asset)
 item=dict(case=e['case'],dataset=e['dataset'],sequence_id=e['sequence_id'],recomputed_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,official={},merged_training_rule={},predicted_last_step={})
 for j in [7,8,10,11]:
  for name,target,valid in [('official',sample['contact_target'],sample['contact_valid']),('merged_training_rule',weak['target'],weak['valid'])]:
   m=valid[:,j].astype(bool);p=target[:,j]>.5
   item[name][str(j)]=dict(valid=int(m.sum()),positive=int((p&m).sum()),negative=int((~p&m).sum()),unknown=int((~m).sum()),weight_sum=None if name=='official' else float(weak['weight'][:,j].sum()))
 for regime in plan['regimes']:
  with np.load(out/'motions'/f"case{e['case']:02d}_{regime}.npz",allow_pickle=False) as z:pred=z['contact_probability'][-1]
  item['predicted_last_step'][regime]={str(j):dict(positive=int((pred[:,j]>.5).sum()),negative=int((pred[:,j]<=.5).sum()),probability_mean=float(pred[:,j].mean())) for j in [7,8,10,11]}
 rows.append(item)
 print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
script=Path(__file__)
record=dict(status='complete',scope='CPU-only post-generation audit; reconstructs exact validation windows and applies existing TRAIN weak-target function only for evaluation; no target sent to model or written to dataset',plan_sha256=sha(out/'PLAN.json'),cuda_initialized=torch.cuda.is_initialized(),source_sha256={str(script):sha(script),str(BASE/'native30_scene_support.py'):sha(BASE/'native30_scene_support.py')},audit_script=script.read_text(),rows=rows)
